summary: Comprehensive testing of new features: 1) Message deletion via trash icon, 2) Friendly match opponent detail expansion with ADD TO NETWORK functionality. All backend tests passed (6/6). All frontend features verified with screenshots.
seed_data_creation: Created new friendly invite from Storm G14 to Monolitten 2012 for testing opponent detail expansion
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new features working: 1) Message deletion with trash icon removes messages from database and UI, 2) Opponent detail expansion shows Manager/Phone/Code fields when clicking opponent name, 3) 'In your network' badge shows for opponents already in network, 4) 'Or pick from My Network' toggle in invite modal shows network teams with codes.

Backend: DELETE /api/messages/{message_i.details: Returns 200 on success with {message: 'Deleted'}. Returns 404 for non-existent message. Returns 401 for unauthorized requests.

Frontend: Messages page trash icon.details: Each message card has trash-can-outline icon via data-testid='delete-msg-{id}'. Clicking deletes message - verified count drops from 8 to 7 messages.

Frontend: Friendly Matches opponent deta.details: Pending invitation cards have clickable opponent name (data-testid='opp-detail-pending-{id}'). Expands to show Manager, Phone, Code fields.

Frontend: Opponent detail - In your netw.details: When opponent team (Monolitten 2012 #MUH2Z7) is already in user's network, shows green checkmark with 'In your network' text instead of ADD TO NETWORK button.

Frontend: Invite modal - Network picker.details: 'Or pick from My Network' toggle (data-testid='show-network-picker') expands to show network teams with their codes (e.g., Monolitten 2012 #MUH2Z7).
